name: Sika® Concrete Fix

breadcrumb.name: Epoxy Repair Mortars and Rigid Bonding

tagline: High Modulus, High-Strength, Structural, Rapid Curing Epoxy, Smooth-Paste Adhesive
summary: Sika® Concrete Fix is a 2-component, 100% solids, moisture-tolerant, high-modulus, high-strength, structural, smooth-paste epoxy adhesive. (Sika® Concrete Fix is also known as Sikadur-33)
metaDescription: Sika® Concrete Fix is a 2-component, 100% solids, moisture-tolerant, high-modulus, high-strength, structural, smooth-paste epoxy adhesive. (Sika® Concrete Fix is also known as Sikadur-33)
attributes: Can be used on damp concrete
Convenient easy mix ratio A : B = 1 : 1 by volume
usage: Mortar, Bricks, Blocks, Masonry, render etc.
Interior, vertical and overhead repair of:
Fixing and fastening of handrails, railings, balustrades and supports
Fixing of window and door frames
advantages: Can be used on damp concrete
Convenient easy mix ratio A : B = 1 : 1 by volume

items.label: APPROVALS / CERTIFICATES
items.text: AS4020:2018 approved for use in potable Water applications.

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: Store in original, unopened, sealed and undamaged packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between +5 °C and +30 °C. Protect from direct sunlight.

items.label: Tensile adhesion strength
items.text:
Time | Substrate | Bond Strength
After 3 days | Dry Concrete | > 5 N/mm2 *
After 3 days | Damp Concrete | > 5 N/mm2 *
After 3 days | Steel Blast cleaned | > 10 N/mm2
After 3 days | Brick Dry | > 1.5 N/mm2 **
* 100% concrete failure
** 100% brick failure

items.label: Dew point
items.text: Avoid condensation during dew point conditions. Substrate temperature during application must be at least 3°C above dew point.

items.label: Substrate moisture content
items.text: Can be damp but not “wet”. No free standing water during application and curing.

items.label: Curing time
items.text:
Temperature | Open Time | Curing Time
+10 oC | 210 minutes | 3 days *
+20 oC | 90 minutes | 2 days *
+35 oC | 45 minutes | 1 day *
* To achieve approx. 80% of the performance

items.label: SUBSTRATE QUALITY
items.text: Mortar and concrete must be older than 28 days. Adequate substrate strength (concrete, masonry, natural stone) must always be confirmed.

items.label: SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
items.text:
Surface must be clean and sound. It may be dry or damp, but free from standing water. Remove dust, laitance, grease, curing compounds, impregnations, waxes and any other contaminants. Preparation Work Concrete, natural stone, cement mortar and render:
Clean, free from oils and grease, no loose or friable particles, no cement laitance.
Age of concrete 3 to 6 weeks (dependent on mix design and environment). Preparation: Blastcleaning or grinding. Construction steel 37, V2 A steel: Free from oil, grease, rust or mill scale. Preparation: Blastcleaning or grinding. Avoid dew point conditions. If prepared steel is not to be used immediately, its surface must be coated with Sikagard®-62 to protect it.
Polyester, epoxy, ceramics:
Free from oils and grease. Polyester epoxy: Grind, using coarse abrasive.
Glass, ceramics: Grinding, do not apply to siliconised substrates.

items.label: MIXING
items.text: Pre-mix each component. Proportion equal parts by volume of Component ‘B’ and Component ‘A’ into a clean pail. Mix thoroughly for 3 minutes with Sika paddle on low speed (400-600 rpm) drill until uniform in colour. Mix only the quantity that can be used within its potlife.

items.label: CLEANING OF EQUIPMENT
items.text: Uncured material may be cleaned from application tools, etc. by using Sika Colma Cleaner (flammable solvent). Cured material can only be removed mechanically.
